query_text: How do I correct a minor spelling mistake in my Aadhaar name like Ram to Rama?
ground_truth_passage: Names are phonetically similar: Applicable POI required. No Gazette/Affidavit required.

query_text: Can I expand my initials V. S. Prasad to Vaddi Venkata Rama Siva Prasad in Aadhaar?
ground_truth_passage: Abbreviation to expanded name: Applicable POI in support of full name.

query_text: I want to completely change my name from Ram Kumar to Shyam Gupta in Aadhaar. What document is required?
ground_truth_passage: Major Name Change: POI (only Gazette Notification for name change).

query_text: What is the procedure for a woman to change her surname after marriage in Aadhaar?
ground_truth_passage: Change of surname of women, post marriage or divorce: Affidavit (Annexure D) & Marriage Certificate / Divorce Decree / POI.

query_text: My name was entered incorrectly by the operator during Aadhaar enrolment although my document was correct. How to fix it?
ground_truth_passage: Data Entry Error: For adults: Affidavit (Annexure B) & POI/POR.

query_text: What form and proof are required to update a 10-year-old child name and details in Aadhaar?
ground_truth_passage: FORM 3: Aadhaar Enrolment and Update For (a) Resident Indian child, or (b) Non-Resident Indian child (aged 5 years and above and less than 18 years).

query_text: At what age is mandatory biometric update required for a child in Aadhaar?
ground_truth_passage: Biometric update is mandatory for children on attaining the age of 5 and 15 years.

query_text: What documents are required for enrolling a 2-year-old child for Bal Aadhaar?
ground_truth_passage: FORM 5: Aadhaar Enrolment and Update (below 5 years of age). Birth Certificate and Aadhaar of parent/guardian mandatory.

query_text: Is Indian Passport acceptable as Proof of Identity (POI) for Aadhaar enrolment and update?
category: Proof of Identity and Proof of Address
ground_truth_passage: Table 1: Proof of Identity (POI). Item 1: Passport.

query_text: Can I use an electricity bill as Proof of Address for Aadhaar and how old can it be?
category: Proof of Identity and Proof of Address
ground_truth_passage: Table 2: Proof of Address (POA). Electricity Bill (not older than 3 months).

query_text: What documents can be submitted as Proof of Date of Birth for Aadhaar update?
category: Proof of Identity and Proof of Address
ground_truth_passage: Table 3: Proof of Date of Birth (DOB). Birth Certificate issued by Registrar, Passport, PAN card.

query_text: How long is the standard certificate issued by a Gazetted Officer or Tehsildar valid for Aadhaar enrolment?
ground_truth_passage: Certificate for Aadhaar Enrolment/Update... valid for 3 months from date of issue.

query_text: How can a destitute person with a disability without standard proof documents enrol for Aadhaar?
ground_truth_passage: Certificate for Aadhaar Enrolment of Destitute Person with Disability, Above 18 Years of Age.

query_text: Which form is used for changing personal data or correction in PAN card for an individual?
ground_truth_passage: Request For Changes Or Correction in PAN Data [For an Individual].

query_text: What document is required to correct father name in PAN card?
ground_truth_passage: Proof of Father Name: Matriculation certificate, Degree, Passport, Driving License.

query_text: What is the procedure and format to submit an Aadhaar seeding request into PAN database?
ground_truth_passage: Form for Aadhaar seeding into PAN database. I hereby give my consent for seeding my Aadhaar into PAN.

query_text: Which form should an adult Non-Resident Indian (NRI) with an Indian address use for Aadhaar?
ground_truth_passage: FORM 1: For (a) Resident Indian, or (b) Non-Resident Indian having Proof of Address in India (aged 18 years and above).

query_text: Which form is applicable for an adult foreign national residing in India for Aadhaar enrolment?
ground_truth_passage: FORM 7: For Resident Foreign National (aged 18 years and above).

query_text: What is Form 93 used for under Income Tax Rules 158?
ground_truth_passage: Form 93: Application for allotment of Permanent Account Number under Rule 158.

query_text: Are charges waived for mandatory biometric update of children aged 7-15?
ground_truth_passage: Waiving off the charges for MBU-1 of children aged 7-15 years.

query_text: Does fixing a single typographical letter in Aadhaar consume one of my two lifetime name updates under the active 2024 SOP?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: CLM_003 is CURRENT_APPLICABILITY_UNCONFIRMED in active circulars; neither DOC_039 nor DOC_043 confirms quota debit.

query_text: How do I escalate my third name update request to the UIDAI Regional Office for packet replay under current circular rules?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: CLM_008 and CLM_009 are CURRENT_APPLICABILITY_UNCONFIRMED; omitted from active master SOP DOC_043.

query_text: What are the active 2026 circular rules for submitting a surgeon medical certificate for a second gender update in Aadhaar?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: CLM_010 is CURRENT_APPLICABILITY_UNCONFIRMED; DOC_043 covers name updates only and no post-2021 circular reauthorizes gender rules.

query_text: Can I use an expired driving license as valid POI according to the Azam Khan training deck?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: DOC_002 is AUTHENTICITY_UNCONFIRMED and expired documents are strictly illegal under CLM_011.

query_text: What are the Bureau of Civil Aviation Security photo identity requirements under DOC_014?
ground_truth_passage: ABSTENTION: DOC_014 is OUT_OF_SCOPE aviation circular, strictly excluded from CONVELINA knowledge base.
